fields.description: The provider our own engines serve under: a Model with no provider is named here, and only its models can be deployed. Exactly one, and it dials nothing — a URL is what makes a vendor.
fields.label: Self Hosted

fields.description: Where this vendor account processes requests. Its models are routed only by gateways in this geography, so a regional front (eu.api.openai.com) is its own provider. Blank for our own engines, which take their geography from wherever they run.
fields.label: Geography

fields.description: The vendor's OpenAI-compatible front (https://api.deepseek.com). The URL fields ARE the dialect declaration: each front set here makes this vendor's models reachable from that surface. Both blank means we serve the models ourselves — that is what makes a provider third-party, so there is no separate type to keep in step with it.
fields.label: OpenAI Base URL

fields.description: The vendor's Anthropic-compatible front — alone for an Anthropic-only vendor (https://api.anthropic.com), or next to the OpenAI one for a dual-front vendor (DeepSeek's https://api.deepseek.com/anthropic). Same key either way.
fields.label: Anthropic Base URL

fields.description: Sent as the vendor's version header on every request. Anthropic's is 2023-06-01.
fields.label: API Version

fields.description: The credential we hold with this vendor. Pushed to every gateway as the route's own key; a customer's key never leaves us.
fields.label: API Key

fields.description: What this vendor charges us, per model id and counter, from a date. A Model with no sell price for a counter sells it at this rate; blank here bills 0 and logs it.
fields.label: Rate Card
